notes.title: Enemies can circle back to the top of the screen!
notes.content:
In the latest version, enemies can circle back to the top of the screen for a second attack run! This makes the game more fun and challenging.

Other updates in this release:
[list]
[*] updated Audio/Visual effects for enemy ships
[*] less enemy collisions
[/list]
